name: Vertical Text
description: Text set top to bottom in columns that run right to left, with Latin turned or upright, numerals stood upright in pairs and punctuation hung outside the measure.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. Each array item or line break starts a new column; a column longer than the available height wraps on to the next.

props.name: latin
props.description: Sideways turns Latin letters a quarter turn so words read down the column, as in mixed setting. Upright stacks each letter on its own, and turns dashes, brackets and quotes to run along the column.

props.name: columns
props.description: When the text has no breaks of its own, split it at word boundaries into this many columns of even length.

props.name: reveal
props.description: When it first scrolls into view, bring the columns in one after another from the right, each descending from the top. Under reduced motion the text is shown at once.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between columns. A number is in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. Font, size and leading are inherited by the columns. Set a height to make long columns wrap. Other div props are passed through.
